info.title: Federal sentencing by district and offense: individuals sentenced, prison rates and sentence lengths, fiscal years 2021 to 2025: data API
info.summary: Static, read-only JSON and CSV files. No key, no sign-up. CORS open.
info.description:
Federal sentencing by district and offense: individuals sentenced, prison rates and sentence lengths, fiscal years 2021 to 2025: The U.S. Sentencing Commission's counts of individuals sentenced in federal court for the nation and each federal judicial district, overall and by type of offense (drug trafficking, firearms, fraud, immigration and 26 others): how many were sentenced, the share sentenced to prison, the average and median sentence in months (prison plus alternative confinement, probation as zero), and the shares convicted by guilty plea and after trial. Built from the Commission's public datafiles without individual identifiers, reduced to cell counts; each district and offense listed had 10 or more individuals in the latest year.

Probative is a marketing firm, not a law firm; not legal advice. Every JSON response starts with a "meta" object holding the credit line, citation, DOI and license (CC BY 4.0).
